name: 3D Buildings
description: 3D building extrusions using existing map tile data

basemap-de-3d-buildings.purpose: Display detailed official LoD2 roof and wall geometry in Germany at zoom level 16 and closer
basemap-de-3d-buildings.dataSent: Direct browser requests expose the IP address, user agent, referrer, and requested 3D-tile URLs, which indicate the approximate visible map area and zoom level. No search, account, or precise device-location data is added to these requests.
basemap-de-3d-buildings.dataReceived: LoD2 building geometry and attributes for the requested visible tiles
